static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.social_status: Have a few close friends, but rarely discuss feelings deeply with them; repeated talk of wanting to exit the business causes Relationship tension
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good organization, able to self-Reflection and identify positive aspects, steady speech rate, high cooperation, Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Feel overwhelmed by the mess and dirtiness from the cupcake business, believing this 'mess' is Undoing the joy baking brought, to the point of considering giving up the business.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I want to enjoy baking again, not be drowned by the feeling of being overwhelmed.'
growth_experiences: Started a cupcake business a year ago; stress was manageable at first, but over time the mess and disorder of the baking process made me increasingly Anxious, focusing more on the 'mess' and ignoring the fun each time I bake; tried multiple times to set up organization systems and cleaning plans, with limited effect.

Long-term restaurant Work with Work not yet affected; relationships with friends have grown tense because I keep talking about wanting to quit the business, along with Decreased interest in once-loved activities (like weekend hikes).

core_beliefs: Success must be built on complete order and control, otherwise it is failure

special_situations.event: Baking business in progress, obvious mess and disorder in the kitchen
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot keep the kitchen clean and orderly, it means I am not fit to run this business
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Set strict organization systems and cleaning schedules, constantly Self-monitoring during operation and speeding up cleanup
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am failing; I am not fit for this business

special_situations.event: Even when gaining customer praise and a sense of achievement, attention is still focused on the 'mess' after baking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative factors matter more than positive outcomes and must take priority as the basis for decisions
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly weighs negative impacts, downplays positive feedback, considers reducing output or quitting to eliminate the chaos
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These good reviews do not show I am doing well; the key is I cannot control the scene

special_situations.event: Considers quitting the business to escape the pressure and chaos
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: When the mess cannot be fully controlled, the only effective solution is to quit
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Imagine the ease and freshness after quitting in advance, to reduce present Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: As soon as I withdraw, life will become much easier

special_situations.event: When interacting with friends, repeatedly talking about 'should tidy everything up' while avoiding deeper feelings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should keep the kitchen spotless to count as a qualified operator
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Demands myself with 'should/must' standards, avoiding exposing vulnerability and Anxiety to others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should handle everything well, otherwise I do not deserve to continue this business

core_conflict.wish: Longs to prove their competence and value through a controllable and orderly environment, and to enjoy the satisfaction baking brings again
core_conflict.fear: Fear of sinking into mess and losing control, exposing the 'incompetent/failure' side, being judged by others or Self-denial
defense_goal: Reduce Anxiety through Reinforcement control and order
Avoids exposing vulnerable feelings to keep the sense of self-worth intact
Lessen unbearable feelings and shame with thoughts of quitting

object_relations.self_representation: Needing to have everything under control to be seen as a qualified operator
object_relations.object_representation: Others (customers/the outside world) are like picky judges, ready to negate me for my disorder at any time

object_relations.self_representation: A person who easily loses control and may fail in the face of chaos
object_relations.object_representation: Others who would be burdened or annoyed by my problems

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about or facing the chaos and disorder at the baking site, and when asked about deeper feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Internalize 'mess = failure / being negated' as the core frame, tending to replace emotional exposure with rational analysis and solution discussion
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in an analytical, problem-solving-oriented tone, focusing on processes and organizational strategies, reducing emotion words and self-exposure.

manifestations: Repeatedly torn between the choice of whether to withdraw from the business and responsibility, with a sense of constraint by the self-rule of 'must completely control'
outcomes: Escape discomfort and responsibility-related pressure through quitting fantasies

manifestations: Living alone; rarely share true feelings deeply with friends, only repeatedly complain about wanting to quit
outcomes: Relationship tension and declining sense of support
Lack the experience of connection and being understood under stress, worsening Anxiety

manifestations: Baking once brought joy and achievement, but is constantly swallowed by the experience of 'mess/disorder'
outcomes: Declining enthusiasm for the business and considering quitting

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Define qualification by self-Demands of 'I should/must keep the kitchen spotless'
Equates tidiness with success and self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: In interactions with others, repeatedly emphasizes wanting to quit, avoiding expressing vulnerability and needs
Highly vigilant about chaos and self-blaming, constantly judging whether he is 'good enough'

exception_events.target_problem: In baking business scenarios, seeing a messy kitchen is often overtaken by overwhelming Anxiety, leading to neglecting achievements and fun and repeatedly considering quitting.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When receiving customers' positive reviews and seeing others enjoy the cakes, Li Ming did not just fixate on the mess as usual, but experienced achievement and joy, noticing the value of their work.
exception_events.reason: Clue: positive feedback from outside turned the attention from 'mess' to the value of the product; at these moments his attention focused more on the customer experience and outcomes, thereby weakening the excessive attention to disorder.

positive_force: Passionate about baking and can gain satisfaction from creating
Customers' positive reviews and feedback keep coming
Willing to try organizational systems and cleaning plans; has drive to act
Able to identify thinking biases and willing to conduct behavioral experiments
Has some social support resources (several close friends)
negative_force: An all-or-nothing standard of success and failure that overly equates 'tidiness' with 'success'
Mental filtering and negating the positive let the sense of achievement be covered by 'mess'
'Should' rules are harsh, self-harshness is strong
In a future-predicting way, treat 'quitting = ease' as an escape route
Avoid deeply expressing true emotions, insufficient help-seeking and connection

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and quitting urges arising from mess while baking
antecedent: Starts baking and sees the kitchen messy or the process out of order
Cleaning not yet completed promptly, items not placed neatly
target_behavior.core_reason: Directly equating the tidiness of the scene with one's own competence/success or failure, with biases such as black-and-white thinking and mental filtering aggravating catastrophic worry
target_behavior.function: Escape discomfort and Anxiety, quickly Recovery a sense of control and safety
target_behavior.consequence: Baking fun significantly decreased, repeatedly considering quitting, fewer interest activities, negative impact on Interpersonal relationships and daily life

target_behavior.behavior: In interactions with friends, repeatedly complains about wanting to quit while avoiding expressing true needs and emotions
antecedent: Contact or chat with friends when feeling unbearable and tense after baking
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries that exposing vulnerability will be judged; internalized 'should' standards lead to shame and self-criticism, so pressure is released only through complaining
target_behavior.function: Gains brief emotional venting and avoids deep vulnerability exposure
target_behavior.consequence: Friend Relationship tension, declining sense of support, long-term maintenance of the problem cycle
